span.p:
1. IN-APP
logged in, taps Contact
on a specific plan

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. PRODUCT DID
dials the number printed on the
documents kept in the car

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. GENERAL HOTLINE
dials the one number
they could find

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
server mints a token
bound to customer_id (D4)

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L3 VERIFIED
line KNOWN, intent KNOWN
menu skipped entirely

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the number implies the product line
and can raise the urgency floor

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L1 / L2 from caller ID
line KNOWN, one keypress for why

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L0 / L1
two keypresses give line + intent

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
every path lands in the SAME place:
a queue + an intent + an assurance level
downstream cannot tell them apart

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D19: the cold call is the BASE CASE.
The app path is an enrichment on top - not a happy
path that everything else is a degradation of.
